sources.name: EWARS Unified Disease Surveillance Dashboard - The Gaza Strip
sources.caveats: Suspected cases from reporting facilities only; the number of reporting facilities changes, so rates are per 1,000 consultations (a proxy, not incidence). Some weeks did not report. Consultations include war injuries. No sex; age only for watery diarrhoea and cholera. Chickenpox, ectoparasitic infections and impetigo were added mid-2025. Attribution required.

sources.name: HeRAMS occupied Palestinian territory - Health services across the governorates of Gaza
sources.caveats: Only facilities reporting to HeRAMS; WHO states the analysis is not final. Rafah has no domain page. Tables hand-extracted from the PDF and checked against rendered pages.

sources.name: WHO fact sheets (treatment sections)
sources.caveats: General clinical guidance, not Gaza-specific and not a prescription. Only the CLASS of medicine is kept here; the doctor decides the medicine and dose.

sources.name: CDC clinical pages (treatment sections)
sources.caveats: U.S. guidance used where no WHO fact sheet exists; not Gaza-specific. Only the CLASS of medicine is kept.

sources.name: WHO oPt Emergency Situation Reports (61, 66, 68, 72)
sources.caveats: Quote Ministry of Health stock figures. Definitions (zero stock vs out of stock) are not stated, and different reports give different values for similar dates.

sources.name: Health Cluster bulletin, November 2025
sources.caveats: Repeats an OCHA update figure; not an independent measurement.

sources.name: OCHA Humanitarian Situation Reports (oPt)
sources.caveats: Weekly web reports quoting MoH and cluster figures; cite the section, there are no page numbers.

sources.name: World Health Day 2026 statement
sources.caveats: Gives no primary source for its stock figures; they conflict with WHO-quoted MoH figures.

diseases.note: not a disease: count of reported events

ncd.en: Asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (classification, treatment and follow up)
Diabetes (early detection, management, foot-care, and counseling)
Inpatient care for management of mental disorders
Hematological and oncohematological care in all settings

ari.note: ARI includes but is not only pneumonia; most ARI is viral and needs no antibiotic.

ajs.note: AJS (acute jaundice syndrome) has several causes; hepatitis A is one of them.

measles.note: No specific antiviral; supportive care. Prevention is the vaccine.

bacterial_meningitis.note: Medical emergency; treatment should not wait for the lumbar puncture.

bacterial_meningitis.class_ar: كورتيكوستيرويدات (مع المضاد الحيوي، في غير الأوبئة)

tuberculosis.note: Stopping early risks drug-resistant TB; resistant TB needs different medicines.

diphtheria.ref: Clinical Guidance for Diphtheria, key points
diphtheria.note: Respiratory diphtheria: antitoxin plus antibiotics. CDC page; U.S. guidance.

diphtheria.ref: Clinical Guidance for Diphtheria, key points
diphtheria.note: Antibiotics alone are usually enough for skin (cutaneous) diphtheria.

ectoparasitic.note: Oral treatment in severe cases; the whole household is treated; repeat to kill newly hatched mites.
CDC page; U.S. guidance. Retreatment recommended if the product does not kill nits.

chickenpox.class_en: Antiviral medicine (only for people at higher risk)
chickenpox.class_ar: دواء مضاد للفيروسات (لذوي الخطورة العالية فقط)
chickenpox.note: Aspirin must not be given to children with chickenpox (Reye's syndrome). CDC page.

supply.caveat: MoH figure as quoted by WHO; same bullet gives consumables 14% and lab supplies 9%
MoH figure; the same page says 343 of 622 essential medicines had under one month of supply
Cites OCHA update 340; agrees with Sitrep 66

supply.ref: PCBS World Health Day 2026 statement, section on zero stock
supply.caveat: Data 'through March 2026'; no footnote or primary source; conflicts with the 44% above for about the same date. The same statement also says '70% depleted' without defining it, so 70% is not shown
Covers 1 Feb-31 Mar 2026; the same bullet gives consumables 46% and laboratory reagents 84%
MoH figure for July-August 2026; 'out of stock' may not be the same measure as 'zero stock'

supply.ref: OCHA Humanitarian Situation Report, 13 Nov 2026, section 'Water, health and health system conditions'
supply.caveat: MoH figure cited by OCHA (key-figure box credits Health Cluster/MoH). The box says 'of essential medicines', the body text says 'of all medicines'. Same paragraph: about 55% of essential chemotherapy medicines and about 73% of open-heart surgery and catheterization supplies at zero stock

reading.title: A cross-sectional study of the burden and risk factors of impetigo and scabies among children during conflict in the middle area of the Gaza strip
reading.who: Hassan ASM, Barakat AHH, et al. · Scientific Reports
reading.finding: Of 409 children surveyed in the middle area, 87% were diagnosed with impetigo and 36.7% with scabies. Matches the skin-condition signal on this site.
reading.finding_ar: من 409 أطفال في المنطقة الوسطى، شُخّص 87% بالقوباء و36.7% بالجرب. يتفق مع ارتفاع أمراض الجلد في هذا الموقع.

reading.title: War and chronic illness: a health center-based study of Palestinians with non-communicable diseases in Gaza
reading.who: Aldabbour B, Barakat Y, et al. · Conflict and Health
reading.finding: Survey of NCD patients at health centres: hypertension 64.9%, type 2 diabetes 44.4%; 98.0% had been displaced.
reading.finding_ar: مسح لمرضى الأمراض المزمنة في مراكز صحية: ارتفاع ضغط 64.9%، سكري من النوع الثاني 44.4%؛ و98.0% نزحوا.

reading.title: Effects of the October 2023 war on diabetes treatment and medication adherence in Gaza
reading.who: Hejaz HA · Eastern Mediterranean Health Journal
reading.finding: Among diabetes patients studied, access to a health facility fell from 90% before the war to 22%, and medication adherence from 85% to 45%.
reading.finding_ar: بين مرضى السكري في الدراسة: الوصول إلى مرفق صحي انخفض من 90% قبل الحرب إلى 22%، والالتزام بالدواء من 85% إلى 45%.

reading.title: UNRWA's health service in Gaza: Challenges and response to the October 2023 crisis
reading.who: Aljadba G, Elkhatib Z, et al. · Eastern Mediterranean Health Journal
reading.finding: UNRWA's own account of its health service and disease surveillance during the war; useful context for the gaps in reporting.
reading.finding_ar: رواية الأونروا عن خدماتها الصحية ورصد الأمراض خلال الحرب؛ سياق مفيد لفهم فجوات الإبلاغ.

reading.title: Time-series modelling and forecasting of acute watery diarrhoea (AWD) in the Gaza Strip before and during the war in October 2023
reading.who: Ramadan M, Shah SM, Akihiro S · Public Health
reading.finding: Models AWD over time; the outbreak model showed an exponential rise in cases at the onset of the war. The closest independent check on the diarrhoea trend here.
reading.finding_ar: نمذجة زمنية للإسهال المائي الحاد؛ أظهر النموذج ارتفاعاً أسّياً في الحالات مع بداية الحرب. أقرب فحص مستقل لاتجاه الإسهال في هذا الموقع.

reading.title: Public health, war and cross-border challenges: the recent cVDPV2 polio outbreak in Gaza
reading.who: Grotto I, Agha H, et al. · eClinicalMedicine
reading.finding: Reviews the 2024 polio outbreak (one confirmed case in a 10-month-old child); the campaign immunised 560,000 children under 10 by September 2024.
reading.finding_ar: مراجعة لتفشي شلل الأطفال 2024 (حالة مؤكدة لطفل عمره 10 أشهر)؛ حملة التطعيم شملت 560,000 طفل دون العاشرة حتى سبتمبر 2024.

reading.title: Leveraging community insights and navigating logistical challenges: a case study of the 2024 polio vaccination campaign in Gaza, State of Palestine
reading.who: Dwyer H, Hasan MR, et al. · BMJ Global Health
reading.finding: 559,161 children were vaccinated in the first round, 94% of the revised target.
reading.finding_ar: 559,161 طفلاً طُعّموا في الجولة الأولى، أي 94% من الهدف المعدّل.

reading.title: Prevalence and correlates of anxiety, depression, and symptoms of trauma among Palestinian adults in Gaza after a year of war
reading.who: Zughbur MR, Hamam Y, Kagee A, et al. · Conflict and Health
reading.finding: Online sample of adults: 72.7% moderate-to-severe depression, 65% moderate-to-severe anxiety, 83.5% probable PTSD. An online, mostly educated sample, not representative.
reading.finding_ar: عيّنة إلكترونية من البالغين: 72.7% اكتئاب متوسط إلى شديد، 65% قلق، 83.5% اضطراب ما بعد الصدمة المحتمل. العيّنة إلكترونية ومعظمها متعلّم، فليست ممثِّلة.

reading.title: Challenges and risk factors for infectious diseases in Gaza due to the current conflict
reading.who: Boussaa S, Dardona Z, Amane M · Eastern Mediterranean Health Journal
reading.finding: Narrative review of infectious-disease risks (water, crowding, sanitation); no case counts.
reading.finding_ar: مراجعة سردية لمخاطر الأمراض المعدية (المياه، الاكتظاظ، الصرف)؛ بلا أعداد حالات.

reading.title: Multidrug-resistant bacteria amid health-system collapse in Gaza
reading.who: Abu Dalal H, Irfan B, Elmanama A · Lancet Infectious Diseases
reading.finding: Correspondence on antimicrobial resistance in Gaza. We could not read the full text, so we quote no numbers from it.
reading.finding_ar: مراسلة عن مقاومة المضادات الحيوية في غزة. لم نقرأ النص الكامل، فلا ننقل منه أرقاماً.

service_signals.measure_en: of all health service points partially or fully functioning across the Strip
service_signals.measure_ar: من كل نقاط الخدمة الصحية تعمل جزئياً أو كلياً في القطاع
service_signals.caveat: Reporting period 12-18 Oct 2026; no count or denominator given; a different measure from HeRAMS service delivery units
